findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, no test files anywhere in app/; all 16 source files are unguarded
findings.suggestion: Add vitest or node:test with unit tests for lib/format.js, lib/cards.js, lib/api.js, and component-level tests for MovesSection sorting

findings.issue: uniquePokemonRefs alternate-form exclusion (id >= 10000), dedupe by ID, and the Pokémon-ID→species mapping fallback in getSpeciesRefById (app/lib/api.js:110-117) are the exact seams the live-data-overlay acceptance test exercises; a refactor here breaks card names and links silently
findings.suggestion: Unit test uniquePokemonRefs and buildPokemonCards against fixtures containing deoxys-normal and an ID above 10000

findings.issue: compareRows implements missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs localeCompare columns, and per-table sort state that survives game switches (app/components/MovesSection.jsx:44-55) — none of it asserted anywhere
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests over compareRows and a component test for toggleSort/aria-sort updates

findings.issue: Filter matching, total count, page clamping (Math.min against totalPages) and the 48-per-page slice are pure logic with no tests
findings.suggestion: Extract to a testable filterSpecies() helper and unit test empty q, combined filters, and out-of-range page numbers

findings.issue: useState(q) initialises the search box once; on back/forward navigation or URL-driven filter changes the input keeps stale text — a real latent bug nothing would catch
findings.suggestion: Derive the input from useSearchParams() (or sync via useEffect) and add a test that navigates and asserts the input reflects the URL

findings.issue: Module-level promiseCache with delete-on-error retry, plus mapLimit's shared-index worker loop, are untested; a subtle change (e.g. not deleting on error) permanently caches a failed fetch
findings.suggestion: Unit test that a rejected api() call can be retried and that mapLimit preserves input order with mixed latencies

findings.issue: buildMoveTables' method ordering, level-then-name sort, and level 0 default are untested; a wrong methodRankMap or sort key breaks the moves tables with no failing test
findings.suggestion: Extract buildMoveTables and unit test it against a small pokemon.moves fixture

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavor (last English entry, whitespace collapse), formatDecimal (value/10, null→'—'), and dexNumber padding are pure functions with zero cost to test but no tests
findings.suggestion: A handful of one-line unit tests covering the em-dash and missing-entry cases

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all: no runner, no script, no test files. The app contains substantial pure logic (filtering, pagination, move-table construction, sorting, cached fetching) that is guarded only by the throwaway acceptance suite, so the next refactor of the data layer is flying blind. Cheapest wins are unit tests for lib/format.js, lib/cards.js and buildMoveTables, all of which are already extracted into testable modules.
